name: Polearm Expertise (Combat)
body:
Your expertise with reach weapons lets you strike foes that are adjacent to you.

Benefit: As a free action, you can shorten your grip on a reach weapon that you are proficient with to use it against adjacent targets. While doing so, the weapon does not have reach, instead threatening the area for a normal melee weapon. You have a –2 penalty on attack rolls while using this feat. You can use another free action to return to the normal grip and reach.
